preconditions.description: The first line of stdin is an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^6), and the second line contains exactly n integers p_i (1 ≤ p_i ≤ i) representing parent vertices for each new vertex added.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(p) <= i for i, p in enumerate(stdin.split()[1:], start=1))
preconditions.description: For each i-th added vertex (1-based), its parent p_i must satisfy 1 ≤ p_i ≤ i, ensuring the tree is built incrementally and correctly.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip().split() == [str(min_cost(i)) for i in range(1, n + 1)]
postconditions.description: For each step i (1 ≤ i ≤ n), the i-th output integer is the minimum possible cost of coloring the tree after adding the i-th vertex, where the cost is defined as the maximum number of distinct colors on any root-to-vertex path.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(cost) <= len(set(range(1, i + 1))) for i, cost in enumerate(map(int, stdout.strip().split()), start=1))
postconditions.description: Each output cost is a positive integer bounded by the number of distinct vertices in the tree at that step (i.e., i), ensuring feasibility.
